name: spec-kit
description: Spec Kit — spec-driven development for platform feature work, adopted whole from github/spec-kit. A skill package, as CRDM became (skills/crdm/): placed here on the owner's decision of 2026-09-26 rather than as a methodologies/ subgraph, the shape removed on 2026-09-22. PARALLEL to crdm rather than composed with it: crdm governs stakeholder-facing WHO/IG work, spec-kit governs folio-assistant feature development by tool developers. Which applies is a question of who is asking and whether the answer depends on what a folio says; the question itself is in methodology-adoption's ladder, and the answers are in each methodology's applies-when.
